votes.reason: Clear cause -> effects -> repair-cost structure in one read, but the repair-cost example isn't flagged as illustrative and its 'current level' cost basis is slightly ambiguous.
stumbles: "8,000 credits × 0.5 = 4,000 credits" / "1,000 production × 0.5 = 500 production" — appears right after the cost sentence with no 'for example' cue, so it briefly reads like fixed real numbers rather than an illustration.

"0.5 times the credit and production of the building's current level" — unclear whether that's the level's total cost or just the last upgrade's cost, since no level cost is shown anywhere else on the page.

"An Erased's sabotage never does." — 'Erased' is unlinked/undefined here (unlike workforce, siege, upgrades, etc., which are all linked), so it assumes role knowledge a very new player may not have yet.
